language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The robot approaches and grasps the wooden spoon at frames 61–90, then lifts and carries it toward the open drawer at frames 100–160 (image, left_ego_image, wrist_image). At frames 164–170, wrist_image shows the fingers opening and the spoon settling inside the drawer. At frames 181–190, image shows the spoon remaining in the drawer while the empty gripper withdraws. No failed acquisition, unintended object displacement, or other side effect is visible.
